location: p. 4, Method / Participants and design; p. 6, Results / Preliminary analyses and manipulation checks; p. 7, Replication of Stelzl et al. / Perception of Frank Williams's nationality
quote:
The sample consisted of one hundred and fourteen physical education students ... shared-win (n¼30),

shared-loss (n¼26), non-shared-win (n¼30) and non-shared-loss (n¼28). ... Consequently, no participant was excluded

from the analyses to be reported below.
reason: Primary source identity is verified (Bernache-Assollant, Chantal, & Laurin, 2020; DOI: 10.1177/0033294120957242), which adapts Stelzl et al.'s (2007/2008) Study 2 shared Canadian identity to a shared French identity. The printed total sample size is N = 114 (reconciled by 63 women + 51 men = 114 and cell counts 30 + 26 + 30 + 28 = 114) with zero exclusions, which is the full 2 x 2 between-subjects ANOVA analytic sample used for the simple-effect test of victory vs. defeat in the shared identity condition on perceived nationality (p. 7; distinct from the shared-identity subgroup n = 56 and shared-win cell n = 30).
